title: Full Body
author: Lewis G.
desc: Beginner Full Body program by Jeff Nippard. 2x a week.

ex.note: Aim for 6-8 reps. Up weight by 5kg if hit 8 consistently.
Aim for 8-10 reps. Up weight next session if you hit 10 reps for all 3.
Aim for 6-8 reps. Up weight by 5kg if hit 8 3 times. Focus on form instead of weight to prevent injuries.
Aim for 12-15 reps. if you hit 15 for all three up weight next time. Focus on squeezing your chest at top if cant feel.
Aim for 10-12 reps. Up weight if hit 12 for all three sets.

ss.note:
Aim for 6-8 reps. Up weight if do 8 for both. Can also use dumbbells instead.
Do Triceps right after biceps then rest after doing both.
aim for 10-12. up weight if hit 12 for both. Can use dumbbells aswell. Do after bicep curls, rest after.

ex.note: aim for 6-8. Up weight by 2.5-5kg if hit 8 three times.
Aim for 6-8. Up weight if hit 8 three times.
Aim for 6-10 reps. If hit 10 for all three up weight next time.
aim for 10-12 reps. Up weight if hit 12 for all three.

Aim for 12-15. if hit 15 twice up by 1kg if possible.
Will burn shoulders, meant to tire you not sort of exhaust you. feels odd but necessary.

ss.note: Aim for 10-12. if hit 12 three times up weight next time. Meant to do abs directly after but not possible with equipment sometimes so dont worry, just saves time thats all.
Aim for 12-15. if do 15 three times up weight next time. Can also just be swapped for sit ups at home to failure 2-3 times.
